messages:
Jin (AE): FYI team — FleetWise POC running into two things: auth failures intermittently and procurement asking for committed pricing for the demo run. Can we spin up a quick war-room?
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'm free now, posting logs and config in a sec. What's the severity from FleetWise's side? They have exec demo Friday.
Jin (AE): Execs tomorrow EOD. They want the demo to show consistent latency + no 5xxs. If we can't stabilize, they may pause.
Alex (Support): I saw a couple 429 spikes around 16:12 UTC then auth 403s at 16:18. Might be token refresh race.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Sending snippet from their client logs: ```
2026-03-20T16:18:03Z ERROR request failed status=403 body={"error":"token_expired"}
2026-03-20T16:12:47Z WARN rate_limit remaining=0 reset=30
```
Priya (Solutions Eng): They are using short-lived tokens from an internal gateway. Could be clock skew or refresh retries.
Mateo (SRE): I'll check the gateway traces. Can FleetWise share the request_id for a failed call? Jin, can you ask them to forward one full failed request payload + headers (mask secrets)?
Jin (AE): Asking now. Also procurement wants a committed pricing estimate for the 2-week POC and a burst plan. They asked about per-token vs flat GPU hours.
Kaya (Security): Procurement will also need answers on SAML, data residency, and whether we can sign a standard DPA. I'll pull the checklist.
Alex (Support): Runtime logs show KV cache misses during the 429 window, which increased compute. Attaching summary: top-of-stack concurrent requests jumped from 5 -> 80 for ~45s.
eng-runtime-bot: ALERT service=runtime model=gpt-compat instance=redwood-prod-5 event=rate_limit_spike value=78 timestamp=1901234688
Priya (Solutions Eng): If they hit bursts, recommend Dedicated reservation (temp) or configure client to use exponential backoff + jitter. For demo, we can set a soft rate limit per API key to smooth spikes.
Jin (AE): FleetWise asking whether soft limit requires Dedicated. They want minimal changes on their side.
Mateo (SRE): We can add a per-key leaky-bucket at the edge for the POC without Dedicated. Ops change, low-risk. I can stand up a temporary rule for their org id. ETA ~2 hours.
Kaya (Security): On SAML: we support SP-initiated SAML and can integrate with their IdP. DPA: legal ok to offer standard template, but need to confirm data residency for embedding logs. Ask them where PII may land.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) Jin to get failed request IDs + headers 2) Mateo to put temporary leaky-bucket rule 3) Alex to monitor runtime for secondary 5xx 4) Jin to get procurement usage profile (tokens/day) 5) Kaya to send SAML/DPA checklist. Can we commit to the EOD exec demo?
Jin (AE): I'll push on FleetWise to send request_id and usage numbers. I'll tell them we can apply smoothing rule now and have security checklist in <24h.
Alex (Support): I'll set an alert dashboard and watch key metrics (5xx rate, rate_limit_hits, avg latency). I'll post link: https://console.redwood.example/d/POC-fleetwise (internal)
Mateo (SRE): Implementing leaky-bucket now. Command I'll run on edge: `rctl add-rate-rule --org fleetwise --rate 400rps --burst 80 --duration 2h`
Priya (Solutions Eng): Nice. Also, for pricing: propose a short-term commit: X GPU-hours for the demo week + overage billed per token. I'll draft concrete numbers once FleetWise shares expected qps and average token length.
Kaya (Security): Sharing SAML questions now: 1) IdP metadata 2) SP assertion consumer URL 3) SCIM for user sync? Also, confirm if any customer data will be stored outside their region.
Jin (AE): FleetWise just sent one failed request id: rq_0a3b5f. Payload and masked headers uploaded to the thread.
Alex (Support): Got it, correlating with runtime traces. Mateo — I see matching trace on the same timestamp. There was a transient auth error from their gateway returning 401 then 403 retries.
Mateo (SRE): Root cause likely short token TTL + retry storm. Plan: 1) temporary edge rate smoothing 2) advice client to refresh tokens earlier (increase TTL if possible) 3) enable request-level caching for repeated prompts during demo. I'll implement 1) now.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a short runbook for FleetWise ops: token best practices, backoff config, and demo-ready suggested settings. Sharing in 30m.
Jin (AE): Procurement ping — they asked for committed price sheet. Can someone draft a 2-week POC pricing with an optional Dedicated uplift?
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll do a draft: two tiers: Basic POC (hosted API + soft limits) and POC+Dedicated (reserved GPUs). Include expected cost ranges for 50k / 200k tokens/day.
Kaya (Security): I'll attach the DPA template and list of required contacts for a quick review. Legal usually turns around 24-48h for basic DPA.
Jin (AE): Great. Everyone — please update this thread as you make progress. I'll coordinate with FleetWise PM and confirm demo slot. :thumbsup:
Mateo (SRE): Leaky-bucket rule deployed. Monitoring now.
Alex (Support): Dashboard link updated, no more 429 spikes after the rule. Continuing to watch.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Runbook drafted and uploaded. Also included a one-slide summary for the exec demo with mitigation notes.
Kaya (Security): Sent SAML checklist + DPA link to FleetWise.
Jin (AE): FleetWise confirms demo is back on for tomorrow. Procurement wants final pricing by EOD PST. I'll collect remaining numbers and repost. Thanks all! :pray:
